Definition: to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to spurt, spatter, sprinkle; 1a) (Qal) to spurt, spatter; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to spurt, sprinkle upon; 2) to spring, leap; 2a) (Hiphil) to cause to leap, startle
